signal_reinterpretation.reinterpretation: False positive. blur_motion:4+compression_jpeg:4 gave 18.95 dB vs blur_lens:4+compression_jpeg:4 20.70 dB in R0 and the lens chain is bit-exact on 3/3 pairs. Directional energy is plausibly inflated by 8x8 JPEG block edges after strong blur. Exact reproduction overrides the 94% recall heuristic.

NO_NOISE (unchanged from R0). sigma<2; R1 peeled residual std=0.0 after stripping the full pipeline; §B ratios degenerate on the zero residual (extreme_pct=100% and zero_ratio=1.0 are empty-slice artifacts; vm_slope=0, var_slope=0, rgb_ratio=0). Adding any noise chain would break exactness.
Brightness FP (brightness_from_jpeg=True). brighten_shift:1 was tested in R0 -> 19.23 dB, far below the HSV saturation chain; mean_shift is induced by JPEG after blur/desaturation.
Contrast ruled out: contrast_spread_ratio=1.0036 and contrast_detected_raw=false; variance reduction is explained by saturate_weaken_HSV:5 (chroma_ratio=0.0) with JPEG.
Order fixed by exactness: blur -> JPEG -> saturate reproduces targets bit-exactly on all 3 pairs, while blur -> saturate -> JPEG scored 29.30 dB in R0. Saturation must be applied after JPEG storage.

reflection_R1.decision_reason: Independent R1 verification reproduces the R0 pipeline bit-exactly (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10) on all 3 support pairs with zero peeled residual. Exactness fixes function types, severities and order, and is the global optimum; changing the pipeline would be strictly worse. The low R0 support PSNR (21.32 dB) is attributed to training/inverse-problem difficulty (0.46M Direct Swin, EPOCH=2, 1.42 GPU-h, severe lens:4 blur), not to a blind-ID error.
reflection_R1.limits: Only the k=3 support pairs in this directory were used; no additional data. Single-image noise statistics are not the issue because the pipeline is noise-free and exactly reproducible.
